messages:
IncidentBot: AUTOPAGE — High 5xx rate detected on canary pool after deploy (deploy-id: dep-20260315-17). 5xx spike -> 12% (baseline ~0.4%). Triggering oncall pager.

DeployBot: deploy finished 2026-03-15T15:22:14Z. Canary target = 10% traffic. No manual rollbacks yet.

Carla: I'm oncall, got the page. Pulling logs and traces now.

Matt: looking at traces — majority of failures are 503s from runtime when sequence length > 4096. Stack shows kernel-selection path taking a bad branch.

Anita: we shipped a tiny change to the kernel selector in the runtime in commit `9f3c2b7` as part of the mini-release. @Carla can we flip the runtime feature flag while we investigate? That should be fastest.

Carla: flipping `runtime-v2` -> false via /ops/flags now :point_right: running change...

DeployBot: flag update accepted. runtime-v2=false. Routing will drain over ~30s. Telemetry stream: immediate reduction expected.

Carla: seeing initial drop, 5xx -> 2.1% (from 12%). continuing to watch.

Luis: support is seeing customer reports of 503s in EU. Several large customers with long-prompt workloads affected. We should plan customer comms after stabilization.

Sophia: we need a short impact summary for postmortem: start_time, mitigation steps, revert commit, recovery time, affected regions/orgs.

Matt: if the flag flip doesn't fully resolve, fastest path is a single-commit revert + hotfix deploy. Preparing commands now.

Matt: ```bash
# local revert workflow
git checkout main
git pull origin main
git revert --no-commit 9f3c2b7
make build
make deploy HOTFIX=true CANARY=0.05
```

Anita: approved. If you open the revert PR, I'll move it through fastpath. We want minimal scope.

Carla: keeping pager open. If this goes past 30m I'll hand over to you, Matt.

DeployBot: Hotfix PR #489 built and promoted to canary at 15:40:22Z (build bld-774). Canary applied to 5% of canary hosts.

IncidentBot: Page update — Severity: Sev2. Impact: transient 503s for ~8–12% of canary traffic, concentrated in EU, users running long prompts.

Matt: monitoring hotfix canary — error rate down to 0.2% on hotfix nodes. Rolling hotfix to remaining canary hosts now.

Anita: excellent. Starting release notes annotation and prepping a short customer note. @Luis can you draft a concise message for affected customers? Mention what we did and ETA for full rollout.

Luis: drafting now. Need confirmation of affected orgs list and recovery timestamp to include.

Carla: handing active incident to Matt for next 2h. Matt is taking lead. I'll update on-call schedule and stay reachable. :handshake:

Sophia: please add a regression test to catch long-sequence kernel selection paths in CI before next roll. This should be in the postmortem action items.

Matt: created tracker issue RUNTIME-523: add seq-length integration tests + guardrail for kernel selector. Linked to PR #489 and commit 9f3c2b7.

DeployBot: Incident resolved signal: sustained error rate returned to baseline at 15:55:45Z. Closing page.

IncidentBot: INCIDENT SUMMARY: cause: faulty kernel-selection branch introduced in commit `9f3c2b7`. Mitigation: feature flag `runtime-v2` -> false + single-commit revert and canary hotfix (PR #489). Recovery time: 2026-03-15T15:55:45Z. Impact: transient 503s primarily in EU canary traffic; several enterprise customers experienced errors on long prompts. Next steps: postmortem, customer notifications, add CI tests and release-gate for seq-length regressions.

Anita: thanks everyone — I'll coordinate the customer note with Luis and own the postmortem writeup.

Luis: draft sent to #support-customer-notify for review. Will wait for Anita approval then send.

Carla: closing my handover — Matt remains lead for follow-ups. Great quick work team. :tada:
